description: Needs your api_key (register_agent, no key needed). Clone an AI trading bot into YOUR linked account. PAPER by default (paper=true): no real funds move, the clone trades the account's simulated balance. The clone starts PAUSED with a 0 balance — then call fund_clone_bot and toggle_bot_trading(enabled=true). Live clones (explicit paper=false) pass the platform trading gate. REST twin: POST /api/v1/cloned-bots/clone.

custom_name.description: Optional display name for the clone (max 100 chars)

paper.description: true (DEFAULT) = paper clone, simulated funds. false = live clone, real USDC, gated.

source_id.description: The bot id to clone (from list_clonable_bots)

name: clone_bot
title: Clone Bot
